description: Step 4 — teamId edit (PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team), ADMIN only. Validate target team exists; reject if displayName collides in the destination team (prompt rename); rewrite GSI1PK+GSI2PK; LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED audit (old->new). Least-privilege Lambda + route (DynamoDB only). Depends on FEAT-001/FEAT-002/FEAT-003.
steps: Add changeModelTeam(user, modelName, newTeamId) to <WT>/backend/src/services/language-model-service.ts: requireRole(user,'ADMIN'); load metadata (notFoundError if missing); validate newTeamId exists via getTeamById (else validationError); collision check: if findByDisplayName(newTeamId, model.displayNameLower) returns another model -> reject with a clear message prompting rename; else updateTeamId. Return { oldTeamId, newTeamId, ...updated }. Update language-model-service.test.ts.

Create <WT>/backend/src/handlers/patch-language-model-team.ts: JSDoc 'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team'; extractUser; modelName path param; body { teamId }; call changeModelTeam; recordAuditLog LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED (metadata { oldTeamId, newTeamId }); successResponse. Add patch-language-model-team.test.ts (covers ADMIN-only, non-existent team rejection, destination collision rejection).

In <WT>/infra/lib/stacks/api-stack.ts add patchLanguageModelTeamFn = createLambda('PatchLanguageModelTeam', { entry: handlersDir, description: 'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team - Change model team', environment: commonEnv }); grant DynamoDB read/write + KMS only; addRoute('PATCH','/language-models/{modelName}/team', patchLanguageModelTeamFn, jwtAuthorizer). Update api-stack snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT>/infra && npx vitest --run passes with the new PATCH team route/Lambda in the snapshot, and npx cdk diff --all synthesizes cleanly.
Non-ADMIN callers are rejected (403);付け替え to a non-existent team is rejected (400); 付け替え to a team where the same displayName already exists is rejected with a rename prompt.
A successful team change rewrites GSI1PK/GSI2PK and records LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED with old and new teamId.

findings: IMPLEMENTED teamId edit (PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team), ADMIN only. SERVICE: new export changeModelTeam(user: AuthUser, modelName: string, newTeamId: string): Promise<ChangeModelTeamResult> in services/language-model-service.ts. New exported interface ChangeModelTeamResult extends LanguageModelMetadata { oldTeamId: string; newTeamId: string }. Order: (1) requireRole(user,'ADMIN') (TEAM_LEADER/REVIEWER -> 403, checked BEFORE any repo read so getModel is not called for non-ADMIN); (2) getModel(modelName) -> notFoundError 404 when missing (uses repo getModel directly, NOT checkLanguageModelAccess, since this is ADMIN-only and must load any team's model); capture oldTeamId = model.teamId; (3) getTeamById(newTeamId) -> validationError 400 ' 指定されたチームが存在しません。' when the destination team does not exist (no re-assignment to a ghost team); (4) collision check findByDisplayName(newTeamId, model.displayNameLower): if it returns a DIFFERENT model (existing.modelName !== model.modelName) -> validationError 400 '移動先のチームに同じ表示名のモデルが既に存在します。先に表示名を変更してください。' (prompts rename); self-collision (same modelName) does NOT block; (5) updateTeamId(modelName, newTeamId) (repo rewrites teamId + GSI1PK + GSI2PK); returns { oldTeamId, newTeamId, ...model, teamId: newTeamId }. New imports in service: notFoundError from error-handler, getModel + updateTeamId from language-model-repository. HANDLER: new handlers/patch-language-model-team.ts (JSDoc 'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team', one handler per file, named export). Mirrors patch-language-model-name.ts: extractUser; require modelName path param (400); body { teamId:string } required (400); calls changeModelTeam; records LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED audit (resourceType 'LanguageModel', resourceId=modelName, metadata { oldTeamId, newTeamId }); successResponse({ data: updated }); inner try/catch rethrows AppError (has statusCode) else internalError('モデルのチーム変更に失敗しました。'). TESTS: language-model-service.test.ts — added changeModelTeam describe (6 cases: ADMIN re-assign rewrites keys & returns old/new, non-ADMIN 403 (getModel/updateTeamId not called), missing model 404 (getTeamById not called), ghost destination team 400, destination displayName collision 400 (updateTeamId not called), self-collision allowed); extended repo mock with getModel+updateTeamId and added beforeEach resets. patch-language-model-team.test.ts — new, mirrors patch-language-model-name.test.ts (success+audit old/new, missing param/body/teamId/non-string 400s, destination-team-not-found 400, collision 400, non-ADMIN 403, model-not-found 404, raw error -> 500; asserts audit NOT recorded on failures). NOTE: no property test added — team edit is not in the context.json property-test-required list (session-ownership on create, within-team displayName uniqueness, team-scoped list filtering, delete order+idempotency, quota-exceeded); within-team uniqueness is already covered by FEAT-001/003 property tests. INFRA: api-stack.ts — added patchLanguageModelTeamFn = createLambda('PatchLanguageModelTeam', { entry: handlersDir, description:'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team - Change model team', environment: commonEnv }) (kebab -> patch-language-model-team.ts, matches handler file); grants grantDynamoDbReadWrite + grantKmsAccess ONLY (NO Transcribe) — least-privilege DynamoDB+KMS, verified in snapshot (added role policy has xray + dynamodb + kms, zero transcribe actions). addRoute('PATCH','/language-models/{modelName}/team', patchLanguageModelTeamFn, jwtAuthorizer) placed right after the PATCH .../name route. SNAPSHOT: regenerated infra/test/__snapshots__/api-stack.test.ts.snap intentionally via `npx vitest --run test/api-stack.test.ts -u`; git diff is +222 lines / 0 deletions, all for the new PatchLanguageModelTeam Lambda/role/policy/log-group + PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/team route/integration/permission (confirmed: only PatchLanguageModelTeam* and languagemodelsmodelNameteam* logical IDs added; no transcribe: actions).
